"""Independent scalar rectangle arithmetic on real saved model predictions."""
import ast
import json
import math
from pathlib import Path

run = Path(Path('/tmp/sharerobot-metrics-run').read_text())
result = json.loads(next((run/'results').rglob('*_results.json')).read_text())
rows = [json.loads(line) for line in next((run/'results').rglob('*_samples_share_robot_affordance.jsonl')).read_text().splitlines()]
intersections, unions, ious, gious, hits = [], [], [], [], []
for row in rows:
    gt = ast.literal_eval(row['target']) if isinstance(row['target'], str) else row['target']
    garea = (gt[2]-gt[0])*(gt[3]-gt[1])
    i, u, iou, giou = 0.0, garea, 0.0, 0.0
    try:
        pred = ast.literal_eval(row['filtered_resps']) if isinstance(row['filtered_resps'], str) else row['filtered_resps']
        if len(pred) != 4 or not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in pred) or pred[2] <= pred[0] or pred[3] <= pred[1]:
            raise ValueError('invalid prediction')
        i = max(0,min(pred[2],gt[2])-max(pred[0],gt[0]))*max(0,min(pred[3],gt[3])-max(pred[1],gt[1]))
        u = (pred[2]-pred[0])*(pred[3]-pred[1])+garea-i
        c = (max(pred[2],gt[2])-min(pred[0],gt[0]))*(max(pred[3],gt[3])-min(pred[1],gt[1]))
        if not all(math.isfinite(x) for x in [i,u,c]): raise ValueError('nonfinite geometry')
        iou=i/u; giou=iou-(c-u)/c
    except (ValueError,TypeError,SyntaxError,OverflowError):
        i,u,iou,giou=0.0,garea,0.0,0.0
    intersections.append(i);unions.append(u);ious.append(iou);gious.append(giou);hits.append(float(iou>=.5))
expected={'mean_iou':sum(ious)/len(rows),'cumulative_iou':sum(intersections)/sum(unions),'mean_generalized_iou':sum(gious)/len(rows),'precision_at_0_5':sum(hits)/len(rows)}
actual=result['results']['share_robot_affordance']
for name,value in expected.items():
    assert math.isclose(actual[name+',none'],value,abs_tol=1e-12), (name,actual[name+',none'],value)
report={'passed':True,'sample_count':len(rows),'independent_metrics':expected,'source':'check-sharerobot-metrics.py; standard-library scalar geometry, no task scorer imports'}
(run/'independent-metrics-check.json').write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps(report,indent=2))
